limits: No complete pre-installation VC runtime snapshot is available in this inventory; post-install versions do not prove which files changed.
Toolset comparison selects compiler, linker, headers and CRT libraries together; it does not isolate link.exe.
A bounded quiet installer sample is evidence of inactivity during the sample, not a guarantee against future background activity.
installation.comparison_recommendation: Measure both frozen old-toolset executables and new-toolset executables after this installation so all runs share the current system DLLs; label the factor MSVC toolset, not linker-only.

binary_audit.scope: Read-only static audit of MSVC 14.35 versus 14.44 for each Rust version; no timing inference

source_provenance.source_map_encoding: UTF-8 JSON of manifest sources, sorted keys, separators comma and colon

limitations: The MSVC factor includes native libraries/tool selection, not only link.exe.
Selected environment and source manifests are not a full hermetic-build proof.
Address normalization is not a semantic-equivalence proof; static counts are not timings.
Imported DLL names do not identify statically linked code or runtime-loaded libraries.
Normalized hot instructions mask external image addresses; this is not whole-program semantic equivalence.
CRT size deltas concern matched public PDB symbols, with aliases deduplicated; not all code was compared.
MSVC update changes compiler, native libraries, headers and linker together; effects cannot be assigned to link.exe alone.
MSVC toolset and libraries change together, not linker alone
Both binaries in every pair run after installation, against the same current shared runtime
Output and final PNG checked, not every rendered frame
Default Rust versions and development executables retained
